articles.title: AI giant Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with 'Chinese spy'
articles.summary: Tech giant Nvidia is investigating reports that chief executive Jensen ⁠Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.

articles.title: Government considering banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
articles.summary: The government is seriously considering banning children from online sales platforms such as eBay and Vinted, the culture secretary has said.

articles.title: Anti-data centre groups set to march in Edinburgh as part of Europe-wide protest
articles.summary: A coalition of 75 organisations opposed to plans for AI data centres in Scotland is set to march in Edinburgh this month.

articles.title: UK has 'new pair of eyes' in space as new military satellite enters orbit
articles.summary: The UK has a "new pair of eyes" in space after it launched a new military satellite into orbit, the Ministry of Defence (MoD) has announced.

articles.title: Health checks offered to residents near one of England's worst illegal waste sites
articles.summary: Dedicated health checks, including asthma and blood pressure assessments, are being offered to people living near one of England's worst illegal waste sites.

articles.title: Just 13% of UK teenage girls active every day, WHO figures show
articles.summary: Experts have warned that more needs to be done to boost the exercise levels of UK teenagers - with just 13% of teenage girls active every day.

articles.title: Blood tests that could spot early signs of cancers to be trialled on thousands of NHS patients
articles.summary: Blood tests that could spot the early signs of a range of the most common cancers are to be trialled on thousands of NHS patients.

articles.title: Cyber attack threatens French blood banks
articles.summary: Blood bank sites in France are the latest to be hit by cyber attackers.

articles.title: MPs urge online retailers to stop selling AI toys over child harm fears
articles.summary: AI toys with built-in chatbots could expose children to psychological harms and inappropriate material, according to MPs and peers who are urging Amazon and eBay to stop selling them.

articles.title: Cyber attacks affect UK meat processing industry, top security official says
articles.summary: Cyber attacks have affected the UK meat processing industry, a top security official has said in the wake of hacks that hit supermarkets across Europe.
